$comment: What the platform offers to a generated tool, in business words, for the scoping role (given as platform_capabilities in its task data). Maintained with the core: `from` names the file of the EupaDev repository that provides each capability (checked by orchestrator/tests/instructions.test.ts); the ids feed $defs.capability of report.schema.json (scripts/generate-report-catalogue.js).

offered.what: People sign in with their organisation account (single sign-on); the tool never stores a password.
Each screen and action is open to named roles (for example requester, manager); a person's roles come from the organisation's directory.
Business records with lists, filters, search and detail pages, by role; a deleted record is hidden, not erased, and can be restored.
Forms whose required fields, formats and limits are checked before saving, the error shown next to the field.
Statuses with the allowed changes between them, enforced by the database.
Bar charts with an equivalent table (accessible).
Download of a table as a spreadsheet file (CSV).
One attachment per upload, PDF, PNG or JPEG, up to 10 MiB, checked before storage; downloaded again by its owner or role.
Formatted text (bold, lists, links) typed and displayed safely.
Reading or writing in another system through its documented, authenticated web service; never its database or files.
Who changed what and when, on every business record, kept 6 to 12 months.
Automatic deletion of data after the period set per category of personal data (purge).

not_offered.what: Email sent by the tool (notifications, confirmations, digests): tools in Production have no mail relay.
not_offered.instead: A notification or a status the person sees in the tool at their next visit; a mail relay for the tools would be a separate platform feature.

not_offered.what: Scheduled or delayed actions: reminders, digests, deadline alerts, anything that happens without a person acting.
not_offered.instead: A status or a due date shown in the tool; otherwise out of scope (platform change).

not_offered.what: Text messages (SMS), chat tools (Teams, Slack), push notifications, incoming email, calendar invitations.
not_offered.instead: A notification shown in the tool; otherwise out of scope.

not_offered.what: Access for people without an organisation account: public forms, external partners, self-registration, password accounts.
not_offered.instead: Out of scope; the organisation's directory creates the accounts.

not_offered.what: Documents laid out by the tool (PDF, Word, Excel with formulas), print templates, labels.
not_offered.instead: CSV export; otherwise out of scope.

not_offered.what: Attachments other than PDF, PNG or JPEG, or over 10 MiB; video, audio, scanned documents read automatically (OCR).
Live updates between users, real-time collaboration, offline use, mobile application, maps, geolocation, barcode or QR scanning, camera.
not_offered.instead: Pages the user reloads, typed references; otherwise out of scope.

not_offered.what: Payments, electronic signature, AI features (summaries, suggestions, classification).
Connections to another system without a documented web service: file exchange, shared folder, direct database access, screen automation.
